title: Dub Town is open. Give your website a little place in it.
excerpt: We built a town you can wander through, where websites become little buildings. Explore the islands, give a neighbor a Love Tap, or claim your first ordinary space free after verifying your site.
description: Dub Town is open: a living map of websites, with Love Taps, little buildings, gardens and a free first ordinary space for eligible verified site owners.
seoTitle: Dub Town Is Open: A Town of Websites | ForgeMesh
seoDescription: Explore Dub Town, a living map of websites. Give Love Taps, visit your neighbors, or claim a first ordinary space free after verifying your site.
heroAlt: Map illustration using Dub Town’s island and square plot coordinates, beside the words A town of websites.
lede: We wanted somewhere on the internet that felt like a place. Somewhere you could wander, notice a little building, and find a website you would never have searched for. [Dub Town is open](https://dub.town/). Come take a look around.

sections.heading: Websites with neighbors
paras: Each square on the islands can hold a website. Open one to see its views, clicks and Love Taps, then use Visit to go to the site itself. The counters sit above the website link; the buy and garden actions are just underneath.

Love Taps help the little buildings grow. Windows light up at night, and a tap gives a building a sparkle. People wander around the islands, and there is life in the water. You can explore without buying anything.

sections.heading: Your site? Claim it for free
paras: Eligible site owners can [claim a first ordinary space for free](https://dub.town/?free=1) after proving they control the website. Follow the verification steps in the claim flow, then choose an available ordinary plot.
The free claim is for a first ordinary space. Extra branches and premium locations are paid. The town shows the price and terms before you commit.

sections.heading: A garden keeps a space green
paras: Planting a garden reserves that space as a garden. **A website cannot use it while the garden remains.** It is a choice to leave a small patch of the town green.
If you prefer a building, choose the site action instead. Card checkout and USDC on Base through x402 are available for supported purchases. You can see the options in the town.

Before buying an occupied space, read the takeover terms: eligible ordinary plots can be taken over, and the displaced holder does not receive a refund. Premium and anchored spaces follow the rules shown in the town.

sections.heading: Come for a wander
paras: We have also made Dub Town easier to find on ForgeMesh, with a direct menu link and a [short introduction](https://forgemesh.io/dub-town). The menu groups products, free tools, live data and guides so you can find the rest of what we build, too.
Pick an island. Open a site you do not recognize. Leave a Love Tap for something you like. That is a good first visit.
